beats.say: Can you guess the highest grossing superhero movie in cinema history?
Iron Man 3 sits at ten with 1.21 billion dollars, behind Incredibles 2 at 1.24 billion. Deadpool and Wolverine took eighth with 1.33 billion.
Black Panther earned 1.34 billion dollars, just behind Age of Ultron at 1.4 billion. The original Avengers reached 1.51 billion dollars.
Spider-Man No Way Home hit 1.92 billion dollars, below Infinity War at 2.04 billion. Spider-Man Brand New Day took second with 2.51 billion dollars.
At number one, Avengers Endgame dominates history with a massive 2.93 billion dollars worldwide. Which of these blockbusters is your favourite?
